findings.description: Included regular ECE. Stale "Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" title on team page, profile, and directory profile (src-prof-chankong, src-dir-prof-chankong). Official ECSE roster (Faculty, Associate Professor) is the EE/ECE designation in a combined department. Would change to cs_only/excluded only if an official source placed the person solely in CS/CDS. Now one merged entry (team page) per the new brief.
Included regular ECE, same reasoning as Vira Chankong (src-prof-fu, src-dir-prof-fu). Would change to cs_only/excluded only if an official source placed the person solely in CS/CDS.
Included regular ECE, same reasoning as Vira Chankong (src-prof-miri-lavasani, src-dir-prof-miri-lavasani).

Included regular ECE on the ECSE main faculty list as Associate Professor. The department name on the page is truncated ("Department of Electrical, Case School of Engineering") and is not expanded to ECSE. Other titles are research roles (BME Research Assistant Professor; VA Research Investigator) and do not count. Would change to excluded/outside_ece if the official record showed she is not in ECSE (for example, only BME).

Excluded as adjunct. Not on the professorial ECSE list; only ECSE-related title is Adjunct Senior Instructor (teaching-track adjunct, also listed for CDS). Administrative roles are not professorial. Would change to included regular only if an official page showed a professorial ECSE rank.

Included as courtesy, not joint_secondary. The directory profile says he "holds courtesy professorship from the Department of Electrical, Computer and System Engineering", and the directory ECSE filter entry lists Professor, Department of ECSE. Primary appointment is Civil and Environmental Engineering (chair). Inclusion would be unchanged under joint_secondary; only the subtype would change.
Included regular ECE. Charles H. Phipps Dean is an administrative title; the official team page states a professorial ECSE appointment, which is what the policy requires for a dean to count.
Excluded as research_only (Research Assistant Professor, ECSE, under Research and Teaching Faculty). Would change only if an official page showed a regular or courtesy professorial ECSE appointment.
Included regular ECE as Nord Professor of Engineering (named professorship with professorial rank); team page and directory ECSE filter entry agree.

Excluded as research_staff (Research Technician IV, not professorial). Eser Tuna (Senior Research Associate) and Luis Mesias Flores (Senior Research Engineer) are treated the same way. Under the convention for non-professorial research roles these are research_staff rather than academic_professional; administrative staff remain academic_professional. Exclusion is the same under either category.

Mahdi Bayat and Soumyajit Mandal do not appear on either retrieved list (team page: 42 entries; college directory: 331 entries, 33 ECSE-filter matches). No official page retrieved shows a current ECSE professorial appointment for them, so no omission is raised and no brief person exists for them.

Retrieval: both list pages retrieved (HTTP 200) at the exact brief URLs. Enumeration: team page 42 entries (1 chair, 20 faculty, 2 research/teaching, 7 emeritus, 12 staff); directory ECSE filter 33 entries. All 45 brief people match a list entry; no omissions in either direction. Forty-two people are on the team page (30 of them also in the directory filter, each merged into one entry); three (Ozsoyoglu, Oshabaheebwa, Yu) appear only in the directory filter.

Optional profile pages were fetched for the stale-title faculty, Hess-Dunning, Barendt, and Xiong Yu; all returned HTTP 200. The directory profile pages for Chankong, Fu, and Miri Lavasani carry the same EECS title as the team page profiles.
